summary: The writer is concerned about the increase in cars in the neighbourhood, which causes air pollution, noise and traffic accidents
The writer gives three reasons: the inconvenient metro, the narrow roads and the falling price of gasoline
The suggested solutions are improving the metro (ticket systems, number of trains), widening the roads and fixing the price of gasoline
The writer hopes the metro companies and the municipality will read the comment
arguments: The increase in cars causes air pollution, noise and traffic accidents, so it must be stopped
The metro is inconvenient, so improvements such as better ticket-buying systems and more trains would reduce traffic
The roads are too narrow, so they must be widened to reduce traffic
The price of gasoline is falling fast, so it should be fixed
arguments_main: Names improving the metro system as the most important argument (any of the three reasons is acceptable if justified)
Gives a reason from the text, e.g. it is the first reason, and the writer is 'pretty sure' that solving it would reduce traffic
